_comment: Return sentences after a foraging trip, per resource family. Placeholders: {name} character first name, {place} the mission's place (lowercase-safe), {Place} the same capitalized, {activity} the foraging name in lowercase. rich = pool still at least half full after the trip; thin = more than half depleted; depleted = this was the last trip (the site is hidden afterwards) and depletedHint is appended.
depletedHint: This location is depleted. New adventures may reveal better gathering places.
